description: This file defines the TransactionalStateAttribute class used for annotating parameters related to transactional state in Orleans. It specifies metadata attributes for transactionally managed state, including state name and optional storage name.

classes.name: TransactionalStateAttribute
classes.description: An attribute class used to annotate parameters with transactional state metadata, implementing IFacetMetadata and ITransactionalStateConfiguration.

methods.name: TransactionalStateAttribute
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the StateName and StorageName properties.
